TRANSFER_FUNDS.description: The Actor wants to move funds from one financial resource to another.

VERIFY_TRANSACTION.description: The Actor wants to establish whether a transaction occurred or has a particular status.

DISPUTE_TRANSACTION.description: The Actor wants to challenge a transaction.

RECOVER_FUNDS.description: The Actor wants funds recovered after a financial problem.

VIEW_PAYMENT_STATUS.description: The Actor wants to view the status of a payment.

VIEW_TRANSFER_STATUS.description: The Actor wants to view the status of a transfer.

SELECT_BENEFICIARY.description: The Actor wants to select or resolve a beneficiary.

REQUEST_REFUND.description: The Actor wants to request a refund.

REPORT_UNAUTHORIZED_TRANSACTION.description: The Actor reports an unauthorized transaction.

INVESTIGATE_EXCEPTION.description: The Actor wants to investigate an exception.
